review_evidence: QuantumInfo/Channels/MatrixMap.lean defines MatrixMap, Choi-matrix constructions, a linear equivalence, Kraus representations, tensor products, and proved identities.
QuantumInfo/Channels/Pinching.lean defines pinching_kraus and pinching_map and proves orthogonality, completeness, commutation, idempotence, and pinching bounds.
The source also contains Entropy, Measurements, Capacity, States, Hermitian-matrix theory, trace inequalities, and Physlib/Particles formalizations; these are direct reusable mathematical prior art.
summary: Retain physlib as a large substantive formalization of quantum information, mathematical physics, and supporting mathematics.

review_evidence: Directory counts: PhyslibAlpha/AlgebraicFramework 127, Physlib/Relativity 41, Physlib/QuantumMechanics 24, QuantumInfo/ForMathlib 18, other Physlib/PhyslibAlpha/QuantumInfo subdirectories 1-14 each, scripts 2, root files 3.

Declaration grep (theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|opaque|notation and similar, with attributes and modifiers) finds no declaration only in Physlib.lean, PhyslibAlpha.lean, QuantumInfo.lean; their non-import lines are only `module`, blank lines, and a copyright comment, so they are import aggregators and stay retained under FILTER-007.
329 of 341 files contain a line-initial theorem or lemma; 7 files contain the token `sorry`.

Largest files: QuantumInfo/Entropy/Relative.lean (151924 bytes, 52 line-initial theorem/lemma), QuantumInfo/ResourceTheory/SteinsLemma.lean (107612 bytes), QuantumInfo/Entropy/DPI.lean, QuantumInfo/ForMathlib/Matrix.lean: substantive quantum information theory.

Read smallest files completely: Physlib/StatisticalMechanics/BoltzmannConstant.lean (def kB, lemmas kB_pos, kB_nonneg, kB_ne_zero), QuantumInfo/ForMathlib/Superadditive.lean (def Superadditive, Fekete lemma tendsto_lim), PhyslibAlpha/AlgebraicFramework/HilbertSpace/State/Vector.lean (vector states PositiveLinearMap.ofVec, UnitalPositiveLinearMap.ofVec). All are small but real formal mathematics.
Read header of Physlib/Relativity/SpeedOfLight.lean: SpeedOfLight type with instances and positivity properties.
Read scripts/check_file_imports.lean completely (127 lines): IO program that walks directories and checks that Physlib.lean and QuantumInfo.lean import every module in sorted order.
Read scripts/get_cache.lean completely (178 lines): IO program that downloads Mathlib and Physlib build caches and deletes stale .olean build folders.

rules.content_invariant: Every declaration in both files is an IO program or string/list helper for filesystem, process, and cache operations (addModulesIn, expectedImports, listDif, arrayImportSorted, checkMissingImports, checkLib, libraries, main; helpText, say, runStreamed, isStaleOlean, removeStaleDepBuilds, knownFlags, toolchainTag, scopeFor, main). None states or proves a mathematical proposition or defines a mathematical object or interface.
evidence: scripts/check_file_imports.lean, read completely: imports Batteries.Lean.HashSet and Lean; defines directory walkers and import-sort and missing-import checks over module names, printing colored terminal messages; main checks `Physlib and `QuantumInfo roots.

scripts/get_cache.lean, read completely: imports Lean; defines help text, subprocess spawning, .olean header githash checks, stale build folder removal, toolchain tag and cache scope strings; main runs `lake exe cache get` and `lake cache get` with scopes.
rules.rationale: Both files are `lake exe` build-maintenance executables written in Lean. They check library import lists and download build caches; they do not formalize mathematics or physics.

summary: Surveyed all 341 listed files (339 .lean under Physlib/, PhyslibAlpha/, QuantumInfo/ and the three library root files, plus 2 under scripts/). Checked every path exists, grouped by directory, ranked by size, and ran a Lean declaration grep over the whole set. Read the smallest files, the three library root files' non-import lines, and both scripts completely. Retain every mathematical source file and the three import-only root files (FILTER-007: the auxiliary navigation path is not verified, so they stay primary-eligible). Exclude scripts/check_file_imports.lean and scripts/get_cache.lean: both are Lean IO build-tooling executables with no mathematical content.
